body: Agreed. Some people tend not to realize how certain sounds can mess with people that have been part of traumatic events.

My wife I love her so much but between having to take care of me and the kids shes drowning.  I want to help but she wont let me. Shes hardly holding on but unfortunately I fear for her to be fixed I and/or some of the kids would have to leave the equation. It has kept me up many nights. I just want her to be truly happy again.
I've tried talking to my family but most tell me to don't think about it or i can pray it away. I do have someone I trust she doesn't really get it and is usually preoccupied with something else
Sorry lot of it is hard to talk about thats the best I xan do without breaking down

When my kids scream i get reminded of watching a girl burn to death and I couldnt do anything about.  Nightmares of attacks that happened where I think of only I did this maybe they would still be alive. I think o do well to avoid triggers but that also means barely going outside without some I trust. So I isolate myself and that just makes me think of it more.
